name: Parity Pairs Latin
rules_text: Fill the 4x4 grid with digits 1-4 so that no digit repeats in any row or column. Clues sit between two adjacent cells and describe their sum or order.
clue_text: Each clue names two adjacent cells and says either that their sum is even, that their sum is odd, that their sum equals a given number, or that one is smaller than the other.

name: Median Line Latin
rules_text: Fill the 5x5 grid with digits 1-5 so that no digit repeats in any row or column. Some clues mark three consecutive cells in a line whose middle value lies strictly between the other two; others give sums of two or three neighbours.
clue_text: A clue lists three consecutive cells and says the middle one is the median, or lists neighbouring cells with their total, or states an order between two neighbours.

name: Shifted Rows
rules_text: Fill the 5x5 grid with digits 1-5 so that every row contains each digit exactly once. Cells that are vertically adjacent must hold different digits (columns may repeat digits further apart). Clues give the distance between neighbours or summarise a 2x2 block.
clue_text: A clue names two adjacent cells with their absolute difference, or names a 2x2 block with its total or its largest digit.

name: Mirror Sum Latin
rules_text: Fill the 4x4 grid with digits 1-4 so that no digit repeats in any row or column. For every pair of cells mirrored across the main diagonal (R1C2 with R2C1, and so on), the two digits must not add up to 5. Clues compare or add neighbouring cells, or the two cells of a mirror pair.
clue_text: A clue names two cells (adjacent or mirrored) and says their sum, or which is larger.

name: Knight Strangers
rules_text: Fill the 5x5 grid with digits 1-5 so that no digit repeats in any row or column. Additionally, two cells a chess knight's move apart must hold different digits. Clues describe sums and differences of adjacent cells.
clue_text: A clue names two orthogonally adjacent cells with their sum, their absolute difference, or which is smaller.

name: No Gaps of Two
rules_text: Fill the 5x5 grid with digits 1-5 so that no digit repeats in any row or column. Any two orthogonally adjacent cells must not differ by exactly 2. Clues give totals of short line segments or the 2x2 block maximum.
clue_text: A clue lists two or three consecutive cells in a line with their total, or a 2x2 block with its smallest digit.

clues.check: lambda a, b, c, d: min(a, b, c, d) == 2
clues.text: 2x2 block at R3C2 has smallest digit 2
